title: Editor experience
description: How editing feels to people: objectives and error budgets, input delay, engine work, opens, and refusals.

list.name: New version
list.expr: count by (app_version) (docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count) unless count by (app_version) (docx_editor_editor_interaction_duration_seconds_count offset 2m)

panels.title: Presses within 100 ms
panels.description: Share of key presses and clicks that reached the screen within 100 ms in the selected range. Objective: 99%.

panels.title: Error budget left
panels.description: Share of the 1% budget for slow presses that the selected range has not used. Below 0 means the objective was missed.

panels.title: Burn rate, last hour
panels.description: How fast the last hour uses the budget for slow presses. 1 uses it exactly over the period; the page alert fires at 14.4.

panels.title: Opens succeeding
panels.description: Share of opens that did not fail for a reason the app causes. Broken files are excluded; see Refused files. Objective: 99.9%.

panels.title: Editors reporting now
panels.description: Browser tabs that sent timings in the last 5 minutes. Zero while people edit means telemetry stopped, not that editing is healthy.

panels.title: Unexpected refusals per 1,000 presses
panels.description: A proxy for edit reliability: refusals other than expected ones (read-only, protected, stale target), for every 1,000 timed presses.

panels.title: Dropped telemetry events
panels.description: Events the privacy check dropped. Not zero usually means core and telemetry versions differ.

options.content:
**Objectives** (see the [runbook](https://github.com/eigenpal/docx-editor/blob/main/examples/telemetry-stack/RUNBOOK.md))

| Signal | Target |
| --- | --- |
| Presses on screen within 100 ms | 99% |
| Opens succeed, broken files excluded | 99.9% |
| Successful opens within 2.5 s | 99% |

Codes link to their hint in the [diagnostics guide](https://docx-editor.dev/docs/2.x/guides/diagnostics).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Burn-rate and server alerts from rules.yml that fire now. Each links to its runbook section.

panels.title: Input delay
panels.description: Key press or click to the next frame on screen: the delay a person feels. The dashed line is the 100 ms objective.

panels.title: Presses within 100 ms
panels.description: Share of presses within the objective over time. The dashed line is the 99% target.

panels.title: Presses by delay band
panels.description: Share of presses in each delay band. Growth in the upper bands means editing got slower.

panels.title: Input delay by document size (95th percentile)
panels.description: Large documents lay out more per edit. If only the large buckets are slow, the delay follows document size.

panels.title: Input delay by version (95th percentile)
panels.description: Compare releases. A version that is slower than the one before points to the release.

panels.title: Input delay, now and a week ago (95th percentile)
panels.description: The same time a week earlier. Empty until the stack has a week of data.

panels.title: Layout passes within 16 ms
panels.description: Share of layout passes that fit in one frame. If input delay grows while this stays high, the time goes to your app, not the engine.

panels.title: Paint passes within 16 ms
panels.description: Share of paint passes that fit in one frame. If input delay grows while this stays high, the time goes to your app, not the engine.

panels.title: Opens per minute
panels.description: Documents opened and refused, per minute.

panels.title: Open time, successful opens
panels.description: From the start of an open to the first laid-out page, for opens that succeeded. The dashed line is the 2.5 s objective.

panels.title: Refused files by reason
panels.description: Why files did not open, most frequent first. Each code links to its hint.

panels.title: Refused edits by reason
panels.description: The public code of each refused edit, command, or tracked change, most frequent first. Each code links to its hint.

panels.title: Refused edits per minute by source
panels.description: Typing and pointer input, toolbar commands, or an editing API batch. Tracked means the person was suggesting.

panels.title: Font substitutions by reason
panels.description: Fonts that failed to load. The editor used a substitute.

panels.title: Dropped telemetry by reason
panels.description: Events the privacy check dropped, by reason.
